business_summary: The Children's Place, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as an omni-channel children's specialty portfolio of brands in North America and internationally. It operates through two segments, The Children's Place U.S. and The Children's Place International. The company designs, contracts to manufacture, and sells apparel, accessories, and footwear primarily under The Children's Place, Gymboree, Sugar & Jade, PJ Place, Crazy 8, Place, Baby Place, and other brands. It offers its products through its digital storefronts, www.childrensplace.com and www.gymboree.com; physical stores in North America; wholesale marketplaces; and international franchise partners, as well as through social media channels. The company was formerly known as The Children's Place Retail Stores, Inc. and changed its name to The Children's Place, Inc. in June 2014. The Children's Place, Inc. was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Secaucus, New Jersey.
business_summary_ko: The Children's Place, Inc.는 자회사와 함께 북미 및 전 세계에서 옴니채널 어린이 전문 브랜드 포트폴리오로 운영됩니다. The Children's Place U.S.와 The Children's Place International이라는 두 부분으로 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 주로 The Children's Place, Gymboree, Sugar & Jade, PJ Place, Crazy 8, Place, Baby Place 및 기타 브랜드로 의류, 액세서리 및 신발을 디자인하고 제조 계약을 맺고 판매합니다. 디지털 상점인 www.childrensplace.com 및 www.gymboree.com을 통해 제품을 제공합니다. 북미 지역의 실제 매장; 도매시장; 국제 프랜차이즈 파트너는 물론 소셜 미디어 채널을 통해서도 가능합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 The Children's Place Retail Stores, Inc.로 알려졌으나 2014년 6월에 The Children's Place, Inc.로 이름을 변경했습니다. The Children's Place, Inc.는 1969년에 설립되었으며 뉴저지 주 세코커스에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
